name: Darkspear Islands Clash

angles.text: As a troll, you know the Darkspear Raiders targeted by this Alliance order are Vol'jin's own people. They defend their tribe's sacred isles.
As a member of the Horde, you face the Alliance side of the fight for the Darkspear Islands. The Horde holds these sacred troll isles off Kalimdor's coast against outsiders.

faq.answer: Fighters are called to rally their allies and attack the Darkspear Raiders amid ongoing fighting across the Darkspear Islands.
faq.q: What is the Darkspear Islands Clash?

faq.answer: The fighting takes place across the Darkspear Islands, an archipelago marked by territorial struggles and clashes at sea.
faq.q: Where does this fight take place?

faq.answer: The Darkspear Raiders are the Horde's troll defenders of the Darkspear Islands, the sacred isles of Vol'jin's tribe. Combatants are ordered to defeat them as they contest territory across the islands.
Allied forces must gather to withstand sustained counterattacks and break the raiders' lines.
faq.q: Why must forces be rallied for this clash?

faq.answer: The Horde and Alliance continue to struggle for the islands' strongpoints. The Horde guards them as sacred troll ground, while the Alliance seeks a foothold off Kalimdor's shore.
faq.q: Why does the fight in the Darkspear Islands continue?

faq.answer: The Alliance Brigadier General in the Alterac Mountains directs the forces. He urges soldiers on the ground to push forward without wavering.
faq.q: Who directs the forces in this engagement?

sections.body: Darkspear Raiders skirmish across the beaches and interior of the islands. Forces sent there are urged to hold their ground as the campaign to secure a foothold in the archipelago continues.
sections.title: The Archipelago at War

sections.body: Commanders on the front line call for fighters to gather against the resilient raiders. Survival and victory depend on rallying nearby allies into a force that can withstand counterattacks. Together, they can rout fortified raiding bands and break their hold on the disputed island strongholds.
sections.title: Rallying the Front Line

summary: Fighting rages across the Darkspear Islands Clash as Darkspear Raiders contest the archipelago. Fighters are called to rally their companions and stop enemy incursions across the islands.
attribution: In-game quest text: Darkspear Islands Clash
